text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I've changed.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~, toootally amazingâ¡
Sooo celeb-level chic~â¡â¡â¡â¡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... It's beautiful.
This style really suits you after all... right?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Thank you, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then this is the shape! Now let's pick the color!
Oh, and of course we'll choose that for you too♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Viv-Cheval presents ♡
The adult Christmas dinner
has already begun!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: An adult's, you say...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Because!
—My opponent is you, Trainer~♡"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That's... because those two invited you without asking, isn't it?
Honestly...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why Trainer agreed to it as well.
Even though it's Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"That's exactly why, isn't it~?
After all, you looooove your big sister, don't you? ♡"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
T-They just trust me, that's all!
Stop phrasing it so weirdly.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you're going to check out the colors, right?
I'll go change, so wait right there.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"A brighter vibe doesn't seem
half bad, either."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, this is troubling...
What do you two think?

text_block_list.name: Both of Them
text_block_list.text:
Black is the only way♡
Light purple...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! 
Black looked super good on you, though!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The celeb vibes really make Big Sis's beautiful skin pop~.
It feels so fierce, like a totally mature date♡

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-But... light purple...
matches your eye color, Sister...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"It felt like we connected, or like...
we could have dinner together just being ourselves... or something like that."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well, it cracked.
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —There can only be one answer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...!?
G-Gentildonna-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm...
How adorable."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
However, this is a Christmas date, is it not?
Then—there is only one color I would ever choose for you.
"On Christmas Day. As I waited neatly dressed near the restaurant specified by Vivlos and the others—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...If there is something you wish to say, please go ahead.
choice_data_list: (Pure white... It was kind of unexpected, but—)

text_block_list.text:
Clad in a white dress, Verxina's nobility and beauty
are more refined than ever—and beyond that,
she looks dazzlingly pure.
choice_data_list: You look really lovely today, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you going to tell me
that I look pretty?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...—No, I'm sorry.
Actually, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I told you it was fine.
Now it feels like I was the one asking for it—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...
Thank... you very much.
choice_data_list: You really believe me that easily, huh?
You believe me right away, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Because you—
you're incapable of flattery, aren't you?"

And so, complemented by the venue's atmosphere,
Christmas dinner proceeded with an air
quite different from our usual selves—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Phew... What a delightfully fragrant black tea.

Verxina's demeanor radiated a natural elegance,
blending seamlessly into a room full of adults.
...No, rather—

I knew she always stood out, but having been so used to seeing her hard at work during training,
I was reminded anew of just how remarkably refined she was.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —What are you thinking about?
choice_data_list: Ah... Um, I was just thinking white looks really good on you too.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you call it a date,
you must be aiming to make your partner's heart flutter.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "In that case, you must not think of blending in, nor of gently embracing the atmosphere."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"With a brilliance undefiled by anything—
snatch it away by pure force."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Surely you aren't going to tell me... that you lack such confidence, are you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow, it really rubs me the wrong way.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
Not to you, Trainer, but...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, really.
In front of you, once again...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder how many times up until now
I've shown my weaknesses."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Just for today,
I wanted to be the perfect version of myself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That is unfair...
...You leave me no choice but to nod in agreement.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem* Excuse me,
but would it be alright if we invited a guest from here on out?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: There were girls peeking at me even before I entered the store. Honestly... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Cheval, Vivlos!
—Come on out.
And so, joined by more members... Christmas night passed in lively celebration.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
By the way... why did you accept
my invitation today?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I imagine you must be quite busy,
especially around Christmas.
choice_data_list: No, I was free. More than that—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Please! I really want
to give my big sister
a wonderful Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Big sis is with us...
she just can't help acting like the "big sister."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I know that's good too, but...
Still, as a fellow horse girl...
I want you to enjoy your time.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If it's with you, Trainer,
I know for sure Onee-chan will have a blast!
So—please!
choice_data_list: ――Well, if my lovely little sisters ask me like that...
――I mean, if my lovely little sisters ask me like that...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufuâyes!
Isn't it truly wonderful?

"Verxina smiled as she thought of her little sisters.
Her expression in that moment was purer and more
beautiful than ever before... completely captivating me."
